en.t: One afternoon, it was a little cold.

units.source_text: 我读《傻子的话》读到厌烦，就去拜访哲学家马咯。

en.t: I grew tired of reading Words of a Fool, so I went to visit the philosopher Maro.

units.source_text: 我走在街上，在一个僻静的角落，看见一只瘦得像蚊子一样的河童靠着墙发呆呢。

en.t: As I was walking through town, I saw a kappa as thin as a mosquito leaning against a wall in a quiet corner, staring blankly.

units.source_text: 这不就是以前偷过我的钢笔的那只河童嘛。

en.t: Wasn't this the very kappa who had stolen my fountain pen before?

units.source_text: 我心想：这下可逮到你了，急忙叫住刚好从那里经过的一个身材威猛的河童警察。

en.t: Thinking, Now I've got you, I quickly called out to a powerful-looking kappa policeman who happened to be passing by.
